sources.ref: NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2, B.E./B.Tech question paper 'B Tech 2nd Apr 2026 Shift 1' (English)
NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2 final answer key of B.E./B.Tech on which result compiled, Exam Date 02.04.2026, Shift First (page 1)

notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs.

stem.en: A liquid drop of diameter $2\ \mathrm{mm}$ breaks into $512$ droplets. The change in surface energy is $\alpha\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{J}$. The value of $\alpha$ is ______. (Take surface tension of liquid $=0.08\ \mathrm{N/m}$)
stem.hi: व्यास $2\ \mathrm{mm}$ की एक द्रव बूँद $512$ छोटी बूँदों में टूटती है। पृष्ठ ऊर्जा में परिवर्तन $\alpha\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{J}$ है। $\alpha$ का मान ______ है। (द्रव का पृष्ठ तनाव $=0.08\ \mathrm{N/m}$ लीजिए)

feynman.en: Volume is shared out, so each droplet's radius is $\frac{R}{\sqrt[3]{512}}=\frac R8$. The total surface area grows, and surface energy grows by $T\,\Delta A$.
feynman.hi: आयतन बँट जाता है, अतः प्रत्येक छोटी बूँद की त्रिज्या $\frac{R}{\sqrt[3]{512}}=\frac R8$ है। कुल पृष्ठ क्षेत्रफल बढ़ता है, और पृष्ठ ऊर्जा $T\,\Delta A$ से बढ़ती है।
